overview.en:
Build and refine Webflow sites, inspect CMS content and manage authorized design workflows.

Review website content and structure before preparing a design or content update. Keep the target site and page explicit and work from the available site context.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 Webflow 构建与调整网站、检查 CMS 内容，协助页面设计与内容运营。

准备设计或内容更新前检查网站内容与结构，明确目标站点和页面，并依据可用站点上下文工作。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Review this site's available pages and summarize their structure.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查看这个网站的可用页面，汇总结构。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a content update for this page using the supplied brief.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 根据提供的简报为这个页面准备内容更新。

starterPrompts.en: Review this website workflow and propose focused improvements.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 审查这个网站流程，提出有针对性的改进建议。
